correctness.rationale: For each blade, white-neighbor counts are explicit functions of the center color and blade white count. A blade with at least three whites is permanently trapped; with a blue center, every blade with at most two whites clears; with a white center, the unique stalled profile among such states has exactly two whites in every blade. The resulting occupancy count gives the polynomial and its extremal coefficients. Exhaustive finite replay confirms the theorem on representative instances but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The theorem classifies every successful initial set on a natural infinite block-clique family and produces a closed all-size enumerator, rather than a routine single scalar. It simultaneously gives the skew zero forcing number, exact multiplicity of optimal sets, and failed-skew extremum, while isolating a sharp friendship-graph boundary already known from prior theory.
